summary: Post-refactor regression test. Backend 5/5 pytest cases pass (health mode=external, warmup=200, analyze success returns full contract with source=external and valid findings, wrong field 'image' -> 422, text/plain -> 400 unsupported). Frontend E2E via live preview URL: hero + how-it-works + scanner render, ai-status-badge transitions to data-status='online' after warmup, sample-gallery shows 4 samples, clicking sample-sample-boardwalk creates a thumb, analyze-btn triggers scanning-overlay with 3 al-dot elements, score-value=75/100, 2 finding-card-* rendered. Severity filter (high) and category filter (mobility) both reduce visible cards (2->0, 2->1). Multi-image works (2 thumbs after 2nd sample, click switches active), thumb-remove-* removes correctly. Session-stats visible, download-json-btn and download-report-btn present. About page shows team-card-0/1/2 in Illia -> Jonny -> Satyan order with 'NGN Hackathon 2026' text. Zero behavior changes from iteration_2.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean; hooks (useImageAnalysis, useAiStatus) properly isolate side-effects. No regressions observed.
Prior comments still stand: silent external->mock fallback exposes only response.source; consider a 'fallback=true' flag for UX. Unused MongoDB client in server.py should be dropped or wired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor validated end-to-end against iteration_2 behavior. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_accesslens_api.py. Reliable sample for filter tests: sample-sample-boardwalk (returns 2 findings, score 75/100). All data-testids from the request are present and functional.
